notes.title: DYNASTY WARRIORS: ORIGINS Demo Available & Digital pre-orders now live!
notes.notes:
The DYNASTY WARRIORS: ORIGINS Demo is out now!
What's more, digital pre-orders have started!

In the demo, you will be able to play the thrilling 'Battle of Sishui Gate.' Players can choose from four types of weapons to hack and slash their way to victory: Sword, Guandao, Pudao, and Wheels; as well as having options to customize arts, gems, and accessories. 
In addition, you can adjust difficulty and various other settings to fit your play style.
Fueled by exhilarating 1 vs. 1,000 action and the rush of massive armies, DYNASTY WARRIORS: ORIGINS delivers an unrivaled sense of realism to the battlefield!

＜What is DYNASTY WARRIORS: ORIGINS?＞
"DYNASTY WARRIORS: ORIGINS "is a tactical action game set during ancient China's "Three Kingdoms" period. Players will play as a warrior who has lost his memories and must navigate the chaos of the era, from the "Yellow Turban Rebellion" to the "Battle of Chibi". Experience the realistic battlefields with massive numbers of soldiers and lead your allies to victory as you battle as 1 vs. 1,000.

For more information on "DYNASTY WARRIORS: ORIGINS, " be sure to visit the official site, and follow us on X.

notes.title: WARRIORS OROCHI 3 Ultimate Definitive Edition is now available on PC via Steam!
notes.notes:
WARRIORS OROCHI 3 Ultimate Definitive Edition includes all of the content featured in the original WARRIORS OROCHI 3 (2012) launch as well as most of the previously released downloadable content, highlighted by over 500 DLC items ranging from weapons and costumes to scenarios.
New optimizations for the PC version are also included, such as mouse and keyboard support and a wide range of graphical settings to allow players to fine tune their experience.

In addition to the heroes from the DYNASTY WARRIORS and SAMURAI WARRIORS universes, WARRIORS OROCHI 3 Ultimate Definitive Edition boasts 145 unique heroes, including Kyūbi and Tamamo (created by Akihiro Yamada), as well as Kasumi from DEAD OR ALIVE 5, Sterkenburg Cranach from the Atelier Arland series, and Sophitia from the SOULCALIBUR™ series!
The game also comes packed with the scenarios featured in WARRIORS OROCHI 3 Ultimate, including a sequel that takes place after the main storyline, a prequel that uncovers the secret of Orochi’s birth, and a selection of “What If” stories and battles that unfold from different perspectives, allowing players to further delve into the rich world of WARRIORS OROCHI 3.

notes.title: Regarding the display language issues that occurred since July 9th, 2019
notes.notes:
The following solution can be taken against the display language issues reported on July 9th, 2019.
Since save data is organized by language, it will load according to the display language. 

【Issue】
・If the display language is changed, it cannot be set back to the previous selection.

【Solution】
When you set the display language in the game library, you can change the language you want to use and load the save data.

  1. In the Game Library, right click the game title and choose "PROPERTY"
  2. Choose the "LANGUAGE" tab and select the language you want to use from the pull-down menu.

If the language still cannot be set to the language of your choice, please follow the procedures below.

  3. In the Game Library, right click the game title and choose "PROPERTY"
  4. After selecting the "LOCAL FILES" tab, click on "VERIFY INTEGRITY OF GAME FILES"

We apologize for the inconvenience caused by this issue.

notes.title: Regarding DYNASTY WARRIORS 8: Empires
notes.notes:
On July 9th, 2019, we confirmed the following issues with "DYNASTY WARRIORS 8: Empires":

・If the display language has been changed, it will not be able to be set back to the previous selection.
・The system cannot read the game save data.

We are investigating the issues and working to fix it as quickly as possible.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this way cause and appreciate for you patience.

notes.title: アップデート内容 Ver.1.0.4.0 (2015.7.30)
notes.notes:
▼ 以下の機能を追加
　・政略イベント「皇帝即位」「皇帝保護」「帰順」
　・軍略コマンド「征伐」「全軍快癒」「全域修復」「慈恵」
　・フリーモードでの「兵力設定」「防衛側増援」設定
　・フリーモード：戦前画面での「拠点強化」コマンド
　・装備アイテム「鉄甲手」と「金剛鎧」の追加

▼ 以下の事項を、調整・改善
　・防衛戦の勝利条件
　・NPC勢力の侵攻頻度
　・NPC勢力が拠点強化するときの資源消費
　・NPC勢力の君主と太守の配下武将補充AI
　・PC勢力のNPC太守の施設建設AI
　・PCの昇進条件
　・「告白」時のエディット武将のバストアップの表示
　・「修復」「大修復」コマンドの選択可能地域
　・一部秘計の効果と頻度
　・武将の再出撃条件
　・部隊戦闘のバランス
　・支配エリア効果によるNPCの能力値補正
　・NPC武将の大秘計使用条件
　・非戦闘中の味方拠点でNPC武将の体力が回復する効果
　・戦闘中の台詞および戦況メッセージの発生条件や頻度
　・NPC君主の出陣武将選定条件
　・NPC武将の秘計の発動条件
　・特定状況下での処理落ち
　・その他、いくつかの事項を、調整・改善

▼ 以下の不具合を修正
　・レイドシナリオのオンラインプレイ時、ゲストの武将の能力値が不正となる
　・君主と婚姻しているときに転籍要請に応じると不正な勢力が生成される
　・侵攻戦にて敵側の軍旗や兵士が反映されない
　・一部の胸防具を装備した女性エディット武将のモーションが男性のものになる
　・一部の攻撃中に同じアクションボイスが二度再生される
　・味方NPC武将が投石車の周囲に集まり、進軍しなくなることがある
　・レイドシナリオ「電光石火」にてゲストが拠点櫓を破壊しても、制限時間が延長されないことがある
　・その他、いくつかの不具合を修正
******************************************************************
Update ver.1.0.4.0  released.

An update to DYNASTY WARRIORS 8 Empires has been released.
The update will be applied automatically when you restart the game. 

* The following features have been added:
The political events "Ascend," "Protect" and "Join."
The military commands "Subjugate," "Group Recuperation," "Mass Repair" and "Benevolence."
The additional settings in Free Mode: "Troop Strength" and "Reinforce Defenders."
The "Fortify Base" command at the pre-battle screen in Free Mode.
Extra equippable items: "Iron Arm Guards" and "Vajra Armor."

* The following items have been modified/improved:
Victory conditions for defensive battles.
Invasion frequency of CPU-controlled armies.
Resource usage of CPU-controlled armies when strengthening a base. 
AI of subservient officers in CPU-controlled armies. 
Facility construction AI of player-controlled armies. 
Promotion conditions for the player character.
Character artwork displays for custom characters during confessions of love. 
Availability of the "Repair" and "Complete Repair" commands. 
Effect and frequency of some stratagems.
Conditions for officers returning to battle.
Unit battle balance.
Ability adjustments for CPU-controlled officers affected by territorial effects.
Conditions for CPU-controlled officers to use large-scale stratagems.
Recovery effects for CPU-controlled characters stationed at an inactive allied base.
Trigger conditions and frequency of certain in-battle spoken lines and battle messages. 
Conditions for selection of officers for battle by CPU-controlled Rulers. 
Trigger conditions for CPU-controlled officers' stratagems. 
Frame rate issues under certain conditions. 
Other minor issues.

* The following bugs have been fixed
During raid scenarios in online play, guest officers' abilities are invalid.
When responding to a transfer request while married to the army's ruler, an invalid army is created.
Enemy banners and soldiers do not display properly during Invasions.
Female custom characters use male move sets when equipped with certain armor on their torsos.
The same voice lines play consecutively during certain attack moves. 
CPU-controlled allied officers sometimes gather around catapults and refuse to advance.
When a guest destroys a Spot Turret in the Raid Scenario "Swift as Lightning," the time limit is not always extended.
Other minor bugs.

notes.title: Update ver.1.0.2.0 released
notes.notes:
An update to DYNASTY WARRIORS 8 Empires has been released.
The update will be applied automatically when you restart the game. 

* The following functionality has been added
・Way of life and adept stratagems can now be configured for custom officers
・Multi-Musou can now be performed with spouses, sworn siblings and children
・"Instant Base" can now be selected under individual orders
・Custom units can now be downloaded
・Custom units can now be placed in custom scenarios
・High-difficulty level scenarios with special rules in Free Mode
・On the pre-battle screen, bonus points can now be used to temporarily strengthen the playable character or their allies
・Custom officers can be registered
・Creation of Custom Scenarios from pre-existing scenarios

* The following items have been modified/improved
・Character still displays for custom officers
・In-battle dialogue and battle status message conditions and frequency
・NPC officer stratagem activation conditions
・Changes to officer dialogue in response to superiors and subordinates
・Volume for some custom voices
・Capture conditions of officers when losing a battle
・Quest time limits
・During capital invasions, abilities are now adjusted depending on the number of control territories
・Conditions for hit stun when taking damage
・Knock-back distance when taking damage
・Capture conditions of enemy officers
・Frequency of system messages when a stratagem is activated
・Conditions for hit stun when taking damage
・The playable character can now be changed when using the strategy commands "Invade," "Defend," "Raid," or "Join"
・Multiple officers can now be selected when using the strategy command "Dismiss"
・The conditions by which non-playable character vagabond units raise their banners
・When non-playable character vagabond units raise their banners, the player can choose whether or not to suppress them
・The playback timing of DLC BGM
・The amount of troop strength expended when non-playable character kingdoms invade another kingdom
・Dash, shadow sprint, and switch weapon can now be performed while performing an EX attack with the following weapon types: "Flame Blade," "Mandarin Duck Hooks," "Paired Fans"
・Victory conditions for defensive battles
・Capture conditions of enemy officers
・Amount of monthly resources earned by NPC forces
・Less of a decrease of post-battle NPC forces
・Required number of generals for custom scenarios
・A portion of dialogue and occurrence conditions for political events 
・Several other modifications/improvements

* The following bugs have been fixed
・Stratagem would sometimes activate after officer was defeated
・Individual orders would sometimes not work
・Setting all allies to "Escort" with individual orders would disable use of Large Scale Stratagems
・Crash when changing Custom Officer equipment multiple times from the Strategum Screen
・Crash when switching Marching Officers with the 2nd player from the Marching Officers selection screen
・Two player characters appearing in event "On to the Final Battle" when playing as a strategist
・Unable to play raids with a 2nd player in local offline play
・Low stats of children born from married Custom Officers 
・Crash when performing a specific operation while on the Free Mode officer selection screen
・Player character would take thunder, fire and ice strike damage during a Musou attack
・Crash occurring sometimes during a Rage Attack
・Assassination quests crashing in certain territories
・Officer gender and way of life being deemed as invalid when performing a specific operation in Custom Scenarios
・Issue where a custom officer's stats would reset on the capture screen when highlighted with the cursor
・Issue where starting Empire Mode with a custom unit that has a set way of life displays a corrupt Xiahou Dun model on the Stratagem screen
・Issue where Virtue for a character with a set way of life isn't reflected in Empire Mode
・Enemy NPC difficulty causes invalid ability offset
・The banners, warhorses, and soldiers of units placed in Custom Scenarios were not reflected in Empire Mode
・Some residences caused the game to slow down
・On the Marching Officer Selection Screen, trying to enter "Individual Orders" after replacing players 1 and 2 caused the game to crash
・The symptoms causing character wrists becoming smaller due to favorite weapons have been alleviated
・Several other bug fixes

・戦前画面で、特典ポイントを消費し、一時的にPCや味方を強化
・武将エディットで「武将登録」
・既存シナリオからオリジナルシナリオを作成

▼ 以下の事項を、調整・改善
・エディット武将のバストアップの表示
・戦闘中の台詞および戦況メッセージの発生条件や頻度
・NPC武将の秘計の発動条件
・武将の立場（目下／目上）に応じた台詞の変化

・依頼戦の制限時間
